summary: Several studies have applied transformer models to crop yield forecasting with varying degrees of success. Zhou et al. (2019) [D0144] used transformer models on satellite imagery and reported an F1 score of 0.725. Iyer et al. (2024) [D0142] also employed transformer models on satellite imagery, achieving a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 0.642. Iyer et al. (2025) [D0141] utilized attention-only encoder architectures on satellite imagery, reporting an accuracy of 0.856. Tanaka et al. (2018) [D0143] applied attention-only encoder architectures on satellite imagery and achieved a MAPE of 0.929. Moreau et al. (2018) [D0148] used privacy-preserving training across institutions without pooling data on satellite imagery, reporting a MAPE of 0.915.
